name: Posterior Ankle Impingement
definition: Painful compression of posterior ankle structures during plantar flexion, often involving an os trigonum, Stieda process or adjacent soft tissues.

typical: Posterior ankle pain with plantar flexion

investigations.principle: Radiographs show osseous variants; MRI/ultrasound assesses soft tissue and active inflammation.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent confirmed impingement may require image-guided injection or arthroscopic/open excision.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha/Snayu mechanical phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Painful compression of posterior ankle structures during plantar flexion, often involving an os trigonum, Stieda process or adjacent soft tissues.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
